posts.title: Review: Build Your Own LLM Workshop
posts.description: Last Saturday I attended a full-day “How to Build Your Own LLM Workshop,” hosted by Rally SF at The Commons. The course was taught by Justin Angel. Here’s my review.

posts.title: Probability: Expectation, Variance, and Conditional Probability
posts.description: Welcome back! Today we’ll dive into some basic probability concepts, like expectation and variance, and explore conditional probability. I’ll probably write further on more probability concepts in another post, but for now we’ll start with these foundational ones.

posts.title: Hypothesis Testing: Assumptions and Non-Parametric Tests
posts.description: Welcome back! Today we are going to go over some assumptions we’ve made so far which has allowed us to use the tests introduced in Parts 1, 2, and 3. Then, we’ll go over what to do when those assumptions are not met and some alternative tests we can use.
